patterns: Official unauthenticated public endpoint keyed by job-board slug
Optional structured compensation controlled by includeCompensation
Public visibility represented by isListed and enforced by the CLI

novel_features.name: Visibility-safe structured job discovery
novel_features.description: Lists only publicly listed Ashby jobs and supports structured filtering across department, team, location, workplace type, employment type, publication date, currency, and compensation range.
novel_features.rationale: The raw public response can contain records whose isListed field is false. A purpose-built discovery command should enforce public visibility and make the structured fields useful without requiring jq pipelines.
novel_features.example: ashby-pp-cli postings list ashby --remote --department Engineering --agent --select id,title,location,department
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents and job seekers get keyless, machine-readable discovery without accidentally surfacing an unlisted posting returned by the upstream endpoint.

narrative.headline: Search, filter, sync, and inspect public Ashby job postings without an API key.
narrative.value_prop: Turn any known Ashby job-board name into structured, agent-friendly job data while enforcing Ashby's public-listing boundary.
narrative.auth_narrative: No Ashby API key or customer account is required. The CLI calls Ashby's official Public Job Posting API, which accepts a public board name. Authenticated recruiting, candidate, and application-management APIs are intentionally out of scope.

quickstart.comment: List publicly visible jobs from Ashby's own board

quickstart.command: ashby-pp-cli postings list ashby --remote --department Engineering --agent --select id,title,location,department
ashby-pp-cli sync ashby && ashby-pp-cli search engineer --board ashby
quickstart.comment: Create a local mirror and search it offline

troubleshoots.symptom: The board returns not found or no jobs
troubleshoots.fix: Use the board slug from jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, not the company's display name or full URL.
Add --include-compensation and confirm the board publishes structured compensation for those roles.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for public career-site discovery, recruiting-market research, job alerts, structured exports, and local/offline analysis when you already know one or more Ashby board slugs.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to access candidates, interviews, applications, or other authenticated Ashby recruiting data.
Do not use it to submit applications or automate form completion.
Do not use it to enumerate unknown customer board names or attempt to reveal unlisted postings.
